meta.name: to-spec
meta.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker: no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理当前讨论为规格并发布到项目问题列表
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你们经常在讨论后需要把共识沉淀成正式规格并同步到项目管理工具。
copy.tagline_en: Turn your discussion into a spec and post it to the issue tracker.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn meeting discussions into a formal spec and share it with your team.

howto.what: 把当前对话和已掌握的代码情况整理成一份 spec(PRD),直接发布到项目 issue tracker,并打上 ready-for-agent 标签。它不会向你提问,只综合已经讨论过的内容。
howto.when: 当你想把已聊过的内容写成 spec 并发布到 issue tracker 时。前提是 issue tracker 与 triage 标签词表已配置好,否则先运行 /setup-matt-pocock-skills。

say.text: 把刚才讨论的内容整理成 spec,发到 issue tracker 上
say.note: 不追问,直接综合已有对话

say.text: 写一份 spec,用户故事和实现决策列详细些
spec 里把测试决策和范围外的部分也写清楚
say.note: 完成后带上 ready-for-agent 标签

howto.what_en: Turns the current conversation and codebase understanding into a spec (PRD), publishes it to the project issue tracker, and applies the ready-for-agent label. It does not interview you — it synthesizes what you already discussed.
howto.when_en: Use when you want the current conversation written up and published to the issue tracker. The tracker and triage label vocabulary must be set up, or run /setup-matt-pocock-skills first.

say_en.text: Turn our conversation so far into a spec and publish it to the issue tracker
say_en.note: No interview; it synthesizes what was discussed.

say_en.text: Write the spec with a thorough list of user stories and implementation decisions
say_en.note: Uses the built-in template, then publishes it.

say_en.text: Include the testing decisions and out of scope sections in the spec
say_en.note: Then posts it with the ready-for-agent label.
